r8-finding2.title: Adjudicate reported finding 2: 'not corroborated by the filesystem' wording (SEVERITY REQUIRED)
r8-finding2.imperative: The handoff asks for a severity in particular. A present, hash-pinned substitute is labelled 'not corroborated by the filesystem' when the accurate phrase is 'not in the fixed fallback set'. This issue's headline deliverable is HONEST REPORTED DEGRADED MODE. Verify the wording by running the tool, judge whether it undercuts the deliverable, assign a severity. DO NOT FIX.
r8-finding2.finding: CONFIRMED REAL. SEVERITY: MAJOR as a defect, NOT a blocker for g4. Reproduced verbatim in my own run: 'substitute: docs/agents/ORCHESTRATOR_CONTEXT.md [agent-declared] -- UNVERIFIED -- declared by the agent, not corroborated by the filesystem' for a file that IS present (1995 bytes, confirmed by stat) and whose contents ARE hash-pinned in the receipt (content_hash 2f79929ecb85851bd54ebf71145b2043547d6cdedc9eea9a91cb1c0786b1b496 - a sha256 that can ONLY be produced by reading the file off the filesystem). The sentence therefore asserts the exact opposite of what the receipt beside it proves. WHY MAJOR: issue-304's headline deliverable is HONEST REPORTED DEGRADED MODE, and render_verify_report (map_orient.py:963) is that deliverable's own output surface - the single line a human or agent reads to learn what a degraded run actually stood on. A degraded-mode report that misdescribes its own evidence is a self-inflicted wound in the signature feature, and it teaches a wrong model: readers learn 'agent-declared means we could not confirm it exists' when the true meaning is 'not in the fixed fallback set'. That mis-model has a downstream cost - a reader who believes the substitute may be absent discounts a substitute that was in fact read and pinned, which is precisely the evidence the degraded arm exists to preserve. WHY NOT A BLOCKER: (a) it errs in the SAFE direction - it understates verification, never overstates it, and the dangerous direction (an agent-declared substitute wearing the verified label) is explicitly mutation-pinned by MUTATIONS 'every substitute reported as known-fallback' + 'the provenance line dropped from the report'; (b) no gate behavior changes - the classification itself is correct, deliberate and right, since fixed-fallback-set membership is an oracle the agent does not author; (c) g4 was scoped to ZERO product-code changes, so fixing it here would have been the scope violation, and reporting-without-fixing was the correct call. ONE CORRECTION TO THE IMPLEMENTER'S STATED REASON: g4-result.md says it was left alone partly because 'three tests assert on these labels'. That overstates the cost. ZERO tests pin the sentence 'not corroborated by the filesystem' (grep over tests/ returns nothing); exactly ONE test pins the substring 'UNVERIFIED' (test_map_orient.py:1075, assertIn), which the accurate rewording keeps. The fix is a single string literal with zero test churn. That makes this a cheap MUST-FIX for the Commander to route before #304 closes, not a costly one to defer.
